findings.evidence: ApplicantDashboard deliberately permits destination /apply. applicant_dashboard SQL (20260830100000_harden_applicant_workflow.sql:389–403) returns DRAFT/NEEDS_INFO rows newest first. A returning applicant can reach this page through Past applications (apply/page.tsx:148–153) after saving a new draft. The dashboard maps that draft to the Submitted step and the unconditional moving-through-review headline. can_start_application is false once any current-cycle row exists (20260901000000_allow_reapplication.sql:32–41), so the next-action branch falls through to scheduleNextAction, which can say You’re caught up. The improved receipt-banner guard does not correct these other assertions. This is source-demonstrated, not a hosted reproduction.
findings.userImpact: A student checking history or returning after an uncertain save can mistake an unsubmitted application for one already under review and miss the need to resume and submit; NEEDS_INFO similarly lacks an explicit correction action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render draft and requested-change states explicitly throughout headline, stepper, application card and next action. Link editable current intake back to /apply; when intake is unavailable, explain uncertainty rather than claiming completion. Add real-page SSR coverage for prior-cycle history plus a current DRAFT/NEEDS_INFO and empty schedule.
